memoryNodes.cue: A difficulty has slowed Lin’s progress, but her aim remains.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 困难放慢了林的进展，不过目标还在。

memoryNodes.cue: The office will move and agreed costs will be covered.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 办公室将搬迁，商定的费用将获补偿。

memoryNodes.cue: A shop closure has ended someone’s job.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 商店关闭使一个人的工作终止。

data.situation:
Three months later, Lin sat with Jo to review her work. She had missed one message during a busy afternoon, but she had also helped improve the handover book. The mistake was a setback, not the end of her plans. She still wanted to pursue work in community events and attain the goals she had written in her notebook. Jo asked whether she would be interested in a promotion when a more responsible role opened. Move to the main building
The temporary office will relocate after the building work is complete. The centre will compensate staff for agreed travel costs during the move. Please keep the receipts and speak to the administrator if your journey changes. Lin: My old colleague says she has been made redundant. The shop closed, so her job disappeared.
Jo: That is a very different kind of change. Has she found another role?
Lin: Not yet. I will send her the centre’s next notice. She has good experience.
Jo: And keep your own plans in view. We can talk about the next step after the move.

readingBlocks.en: Three months later, Lin sat with Jo to review her work. She had missed one message during a busy afternoon, but she had also helped improve the handover book. The mistake was a setback, not the end of her plans. She still wanted to pursue work in community events and attain the goals she had written in her notebook. Jo asked whether she would be interested in a promotion when a more responsible role opened.
readingBlocks.zh: 三个月后，林和乔一起回顾工作。她曾在一个忙碌下午漏看一条留言，也帮助改进了交接本。错误是个挫折，并没有终结她的计划。她仍想从事社区活动工作，实现写在笔记本里的目标。乔问，如果以后有责任更多的岗位，她是否对晋升有兴趣。

readingBlocks.en:
Move to the main building
The temporary office will relocate after the building work is complete. The centre will compensate staff for agreed travel costs during the move. Please keep the receipts and speak to the administrator if your journey changes.
readingBlocks.zh:
搬往主楼
施工完成后，临时办公室将搬迁。中心会补偿搬迁期间商定的交通费用。请保留收据，如果通勤发生变化，向管理人员说明。
readingBlocks.title: The relocation letter

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: My old colleague says she has been made redundant. The shop closed, so her job disappeared.
Jo: That is a very different kind of change. Has she found another role?
Lin: Not yet. I will send her the centre’s next notice. She has good experience.
Jo: And keep your own plans in view. We can talk about the next step after the move.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：老同事说她被裁员了。商店关门，她的工作岗位也消失了。
乔：那是很不同的一种变化。她找到新工作了吗？
林：还没有，我会把中心下一张招聘告示发给她。她有不错的经验。
乔：也别忘了自己的计划。搬迁后，我们再谈下一步。

glossary.zh: 阻碍或延误进展的困难；挫折
glossary.example: The missed message was a setback.
glossary.exampleZh: 漏看的留言是一个挫折。

externalEvidence.definition: an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating

glossary.zh: 努力寻求或从事某个目标、事业
glossary.note: pursue a career/goal；本句不是追赶某人。
glossary.example: Lin wants to pursue a career in community events.
glossary.exampleZh: 林想从事社区活动工作。

externalEvidence.definition: carry out or participate in an activity; be involved in

glossary.zh: 通过努力达到目标或某种水平
glossary.example: She hopes to attain the goals in her notebook.
glossary.exampleZh: 她希望实现笔记本里的目标。

glossary.note: a promotion；本例指职位晋升，不是促销。
glossary.example: Jo asks whether Lin would be interested in a promotion.
glossary.exampleZh: 乔询问林是否对晋升有兴趣。

externalEvidence.definition: act of raising in rank or position

glossary.note: relocate to + 地点；可用于个人、团队或办公室。
glossary.example: The office will relocate to the main building.

externalEvidence.definition: become established in a new location

glossary.zh: 为损失或费用等给予补偿
glossary.note: compensate someone for something；本例为费用补偿。
glossary.example: The centre will compensate staff for agreed travel costs.
glossary.exampleZh: 中心会补偿员工商定的交通费用。

externalEvidence.definition: make amends for; pay compensation for

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Paying compensation for expense/loss, with compensate someone for something.

glossary.zh: 因岗位不再需要而被裁员
glossary.note: 英式用法；was/has been made redundant均可按时间使用。
glossary.example: Her colleague was made redundant when the shop closed.
glossary.exampleZh: 商店关闭时，她的同事被裁员了。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: British employment expression: a job disappears because work is no longer required; source form is retained.
